out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. Tiny insects or fruit f.lies observed around drains.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. Obtain pest control Services to control and eliminate insects presence on premises. Use professional pest control services. Only certified pest control professionals are allowed to dispense insecticides in a food establishment.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Refuse Areas & Enclosures Maintained Clean
violations.observation: Excessive buildup of waste grease and debris, were observed on the ground, under, and around the bulk waste grease container located next to the dumpster fence, outside the facility. The grease was also noted to be running off to the parking area.
violations.corrective_action: The grease and refuse storage areas and enclosure for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be maintained free of unnecessary items and kept clean. Remove the build-up greases off the ground, to prevent rodent and other pest infestation.

violations.title: Receptacles, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: The exterior surfaces of the build waste grease container was observed with excessive grease and debris build-up .
violations.corrective_action: Clean the surfaces of this container to prevent attracting pests.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the walk-in freezer door has a large build-up of ice, could be due an improper functioning of the heat-element. The ice buildup extends to the floor, near the door of the walk-in freezer as well.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities.
